description: This PHP class 'AutoFit' is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library, managing auto-fitting functionality for worksheet columns and handling auto-filter ranges within a worksheet.

classes.name: AutoFit
classes.description: Handles auto-fitting columns and managing auto-filter ranges within a worksheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing AutoFit with a specific worksheet.

methods.name: getAutoFilterIndentRanges
methods.description: Retrieves auto-filter indentation ranges for the worksheet, including tables with header rows and filters.

methods.name: getAutoFilterIndentRange
methods.description: Calculates the auto-filter indentation range for a given auto-filter, returning a string range.
